Name: Krobus sells Sewers and Bug Lair items.
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
This mod adds items to Krobus (ShadowShop) for sale. All items can be found in the Sewers and/or Mutant Bug Lair. 
Adds:
Slime Jack, 
Bug Meat,
Carp, 
Green Algae,
White Algae,
Algae Soup.
Clay
Fiber
Ancient Seed
Dwarf Scroll I
Dwarf Scroll IV
Rice Shoots

You can also choose to have Korbus sell garbage. I figure if he found it, he would sell it. Buying garbage does count towards Community Cleanup special order. 
Adds:
Trash,
Drift Wood,
Soggy Newspaper,
Broken CD,
Broken Glasses,
JoJo Cola, //Does not count as part of Community Cleanup special order.
Both Rotten Plants. //Does not count as part of Community Cleanup special order.

Garbage can be recycled into items such as refined quartz.
If there is an item you feel I missed, let me know.

If you like this mod, please endorse it and take a look at my other mods.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/sadnumbme/mods]sadnumbme's Mods[/url]

Thanks for reading.
